|lore=Mara Jade posed as a dancer at Jabba’s Palace in an attempt to complete her master’s task and kill Luke. Musician. Spy. Unable to convince Jabba to take her on his skiff.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploys only to a site as an Undercover spy. Reduces Luke’s forfeit and immunity to attrition by 2 while present. During opponent’s control phase, Arica may “break cover” to fire one weapon (for free). Immune to attrition &lt; 4.<ref name="foil-face" />
